status: reviewed contract; fail closed on any unknown table, sequence, trigger, policy or reference

rules.D1-ledger: Migration ledger. The target ledger is produced by the shipped installer; the archived source ledger is retained as original proof and must name the same shipped release.
rules.D2-capture-targets: Recovery-capture target registry. Rendered by the shipped installer from the target schema; archived rows must equal the target rows exactly.
rules.D3-retained-fingerprints: Retained executable fingerprint projections. Target rows come from the shipped installer; the archived signature roster must match and archived fingerprints are original proof only.
rules.D4-canonical-registry: Canonical executable registry. Target records are rendered and authenticated by the shipped installer and installation authenticator; archived records are original proof only, never imported or repinned.
rules.D5-display-fingerprints: Historical display fingerprint owner. Target rows come from the shipped installer; archived rows are original proof only; signatures must match, fingerprints are never blanket repinned.
rules.D6-enrollment-maintenance: Conversion enrollment queue. Maintenance state the shipped enrollment trigger re-derives while restored units are imported; archived keys must be a subset of the re-derived keys and the generation counter is installation-local. Re-enrolled units are reconverted idempotently.
rules.D-import-csv-index: Rebuildable CSV record offsets and private chunk staging. The target recreates these from the authorized source on next use.
rules.D9-envelope-scan: Derived historical envelope scan cursor. The target restarts its bounded inventory scan after restoring durable envelopes.
rules.D10-crm-summary-projection: CRM summary projection. Rebuild atomically from exact restored facts and verify current leaves against archived history.
rules.D11-crm-summary-credential: CRM summary signing material. Sealed and restored through its bounded encrypted credential artifact.
rules.D8-transaction-scratch: Transaction-local settings proof. A committed snapshot must be empty. The target never imports this table.
rules.D7-contract-witness: Registry-guard catalog witness (8276). Installation-local catalog tuple identities for the guard fast path; never imported. The import ends with the owner-only native_turn_contract_witness_refresh(), which re-records it from the restored target catalog.
rules.F1-durable-fact: User, workspace, conversation and operational fact. Imported exactly under canonical constraints; post-import row digests must equal the archived digests.
rules.F2-authority-epoch: Durable authority epoch or revision state. Imported exactly; when the shipped installer seeds an initial value, the archived value replaces that seed by primary key.
rules.R1-regprocedure-slot: Durable logical definition with named regprocedure slots. Slots are exported as schema-qualified signatures and rebound only through the authenticated target catalog; an unresolvable or unshipped signature refuses.

sequenceRule: S1-durable-sequence: sequence positions are durable identifiers; restored exactly after import and never behind the restored maximum.

triggerRules.fires: Structural validator or fixpoint NEW-row stamp. Fires for every imported row; the tables a structural validator reads are imported first (validatorOrder) and its effect on the row must reproduce the archived row (digest).
triggerRules.suspended:derived-effect: Writes another durable relation. Its output is itself archived and imported exactly; suspended by exact name inside the import transaction and re-enabled before commit.
triggerRules.suspended:notification: Notifies runtime listeners. The restored installation has no activated listeners; suspended by exact name and re-enabled before commit.
triggerRules.suspended:creation-admission: Consumes a transaction-local creation admission. Restored facts were admitted at origin and are not new creations; suspended by exact name and re-enabled before commit.
triggerRules.suspended:creation-currency: Creation-time currency guard. Requires a referenced source to be at its current version when a new row is written; restored historical rows were admitted at origin and their sources may have advanced since. Suspended by exact name; exact digests and post-import authentication still apply.
triggerRules.fires:contract-bound: Required enabled by the authenticated native contract roots (disabling it makes a root guard false), so it fires during import even though it writes or guards. Its writes must reproduce archived rows exactly or target a re-derived (D6) table.
triggerRules.suspended:contract-window: Contract-bound creation-time currency guard that cannot re-admit a historical row outside its origin transaction. Suspended by exact name only while its own table is imported, re-enabled before any other table or deferred validation; the native contract roots must be current again immediately afterwards.
triggerRules.suspended:restoration-stamp: Generic updated_at stamp on a table the restore updates by primary key (deferred cycle reference or seed replacement). Suspended so the archived timestamp is restored exactly.
triggerRules.fires:recovery-capture: Erasure capture. Fires but is inert: the import never enables the capture setting.
triggerRules.suspended:origin-validator: Validator whose check reads origin-time state: the acting user, session settings or admission receipts, the clock, the row's own status at creation, or the then-current state of another relation (currency, membership, policy, held or erased sources, current schema), including rows written later in the import because their deriving trigger is suspended. It would refuse a fact admitted at origin; suspended by exact name for the import transaction and re-enabled before commit, with the same enablement and digest checks. A contract-bound one is windowed instead.
triggerRules.suspended:restoration-placeholder: Trigger on a table restored with deferred NULL placeholders whose body reads a deferred column or the whole row. At INSERT it would judge the placeholder and on the primary-key fixup the import's own restoration update, never the archived row; suspended for the import transaction and re-enabled before commit.
triggerRules.suspended:origin-stamp: BEFORE INSERT stamp whose value comes from origin-time state rather than from the archived row: the row's own write history (for example the lease token a release cleared), the clock, randomness, session settings, or another relation at that moment. Re-firing it would overwrite an archived durable value or refuse a historical row, so it is suspended by exact name for the import transaction and re-enabled before commit; exact digests and post-import authentication still apply. A reviewed origin stamp that a native contract root requires refuses the roster build.
